summary: Iteration 157: Complete testing of 10 Equipment Email Templates for equipment sales flow. All 12 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified - templates visible in Configuración > Plantillas de Correo, grouped by sede (5 PYME + 5 CORP), editable via dialog with variables sidebar.

minor.issue: Equipment templates return 404 on reset because they are seeded directly to DB, not in default templates dictionary. This is expected behavior.

critical_code_review_comments: All 10 equipment templates exist in DB: equipment_sent_PYME/CORP, equipment_approved_PYME/CORP, equipment_invoice_PYME/CORP, equipment_collect_PYME/CORP, equipment_delivery_PYME/CORP
GET /api/email-templates returns all 35 templates including 10 equipment templates
Templates are editable via PUT /api/email-templates/{template_id} - verified with edit and restore
Template layout verified: header #003366 blue, 900px max-width present in HTML
Frontend UI shows templates grouped by sede (Plantillas Sede Pyme / Plantillas Sede Corp)
Edit dialog includes subject input, body HTML textarea, and variables sidebar with categories
workflow_notifications.py has _resolve_template_by_base function for template resolution
quote_actions.py references equipment_approved, equipment_sent, equipment_invoice, equipment_collect templates
template_base_override parameter in send_workflow_notification enables equipment template selection
seed_data_creation: None - equipment templates already seeded in DB
context_for_next_testing_agent: Equipment email templates (10 total) are fully functional. Templates are stored in MongoDB email_templates collection with template_id pattern: equipment_{action}_{SEDE}. The workflow uses template_base_override parameter to select equipment-specific templates when quote_category='equipment'. Frontend displays templates in /settings page under 'Plantillas de Correo Electrónico' section.
